name: Craft CMS
description_en:
Craft CMS is a developer-oriented PHP content management system with custom fields, structured authoring, multi-site/localization and a choice of Twig templates or a decoupled GraphQL front end. It can run on customer-managed infrastructure; Craft Cloud is a separate managed hosting service. Craft Commerce and other plugins extend the installation rather than being universally included in the CMS license.

Evaluate the content model, author permissions and operating environment before the license tier. Solo is free with one user, Team/Pro add collaboration and professional controls, and update eligibility is separate from the perpetual right to keep running a licensed version. Public licensing guidance and older service terms disagree about Solo commercial/client use, which should be resolved before a business deployment.
description_zh:
Craft CMS 是面向开发者的 PHP 内容管理系统，支持自定义字段、结构化创作、多站/本地化，可用 Twig 模板或解耦 GraphQL 前端。它可运行在客户管理的基础设施，Craft Cloud 是独立托管服务；Craft Commerce 及其他插件用于扩展安装，不是每份 CMS 许可都包含。

应先评估内容模型、作者权限及运行环境，再选许可档。Solo 免费但只有一个用户，Team/Pro 增加协作与专业控制；更新资格与永久运行已许可版本的权利分开。公开许可指引与旧服务条款在 Solo 商业/客户项目使用上有差异，企业部署前需澄清。

core_features.explanation_en: Define fields and element layouts, then render/query by their handles; translation rules can vary by site, group or language.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定义字段和元素布局，通过 handle 渲染/查询，翻译规则可按站点、分组或语言区分。

core_features.explanation_en: Twig templates or a GraphQL front end can use Craft-managed content; developers remain responsible for implementation and deployment.
core_features.explanation_zh: Twig 或 GraphQL 前端可使用 Craft 内容，开发者仍负责实现和部署。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid licenses include a year of updates/support; newly installed versions must be deployed during eligibility to become perpetually licensed.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费许可含一年更新/支持，新安装版本须在资格期内部署才取得永久许可。

pricing.summary_en: Solo free1user; Team(Craft5)$279/project5users, Pro$399/projectunlimited, one-year updates then displayed$99/year. Plugins/hosting separate. Solo commercial-use guidance conflicts with terms; confirm current rights and checkout currency.
pricing.summary_zh: Solo 免费1人，Team(Craft5)每项目$279/5人，Pro$399/不限，含一年更新后显示$99/年。插件/托管另计，Solo商业使用指引与条款冲突，当前权利及结账币种需确认。

sections.title_zh: 使用明确版本的开发环境
sections.en: The Craft5 installation guide recommends local DDEV/Docker and an official Composer starter, then control-panel setup; it is a local quickstart, not a complete production deployment. Its requirements list PHP8.2+, Composer2, MySQL8.0.17+/MariaDB10.4.6+/PostgreSQL13+, PHP256MB and required extensions. More resources may be needed, and the guide discourages MariaDB for many users/large content volumes. Validate the chosen Craft version’s requirements, queue/mail capabilities, writable directories and database privileges before choosing a host. The docs explicitly warn against777 permissions and root HTTP/PHP processes on live/shared environments. No Docker, database or CMS was installed here.
sections.zh: Craft5 安装指南建议使用本地 DDEV/Docker 和官方 Composer starter，再设置控制面板；这是本地入门，不是完整生产部署。要求列出 PHP8.2、Composer2、MySQL8.0.17/MariaDB10.4.6/PostgreSQL13 及以上、PHP256MB 和扩展。实际可能需要更多资源，指南不建议大量用户/内容使用 MariaDB。选择主机前应核对所选 Craft 版本要求、队列/邮件、可写目录及数据库权限。文档明确反对线上/共享环境使用777权限及 root HTTP/PHP进程。本次未安装 Docker、数据库或 CMS。

sections.title_en: Model one real editorial content type
sections.title_zh: 建立一个真实编辑内容类型
sections.en: For a publication, prototype an Article entry with title, summary, hero image and body rather than beginning with a generic page builder. Create fields under Settings → Fields, give each a stable handle and place them in an entry-type field layout. The field type controls storage, editor UI, template data and query behavior. Translation can share a value everywhere or separate it by site, language, site group or a custom key. Use a second language to verify the intended sharing rather than assuming multi-site automatically means every field is independently translated. Check author permissions and preview on representative content; frontend rendering, search and integrations require implementation.
sections.zh: 以出版站为例，可先建立含标题、摘要、主图和正文的 Article，而非先做通用页面构建器。在 Settings → Fields 建字段、设置稳定 handle，再放入 entry type 的字段布局。字段类型控制存储、编辑界面、模板数据和查询行为。翻译可全站共享，也可按站点、语言、分组或自定义键分开。应使用第二语言验证实际共享规则，不能认为多站自动意味着全部字段独立翻译。用代表内容检查作者权限和预览，前端渲染、搜索及集成仍需实现。

sections.title_en: Separate CMS, plugins and hosting costs
sections.title_zh: 区分 CMS、插件和托管费用
sections.en: The self-hosted table lists Solo free with one account; Team$279/project with up to five accounts and one user group, explicitly Craft5-only; Pro$399/project with unlimited users/groups and branded control panel/communication. Team/Pro include one year of updates, then display$99/year for updates. Currency code/tax need checkout confirmation. CMS licenses may be included with corresponding Craft Cloud hosting, but commercial plugins remain separately licensed. Forms and SEO are marked “With Plugin”; first-party commerce compatibility is not proof the store license/payment fees are included. Hosted pricing and resources require a separate Cloud quote. Trialing Team/Pro is allowed on non-public-looking development domains, not an unrestricted free production right.
sections.zh: 自托管表列 Solo 免费一个账户，Team 每项目$279、最多五账户/一个用户组，并明确仅 Craft5；Pro 每项目$399、用户/组不限及品牌化控制面板/通信。Team/Pro 含一年更新，之后显示更新$99/年，币种代码/税费需结账确认。对应 Craft Cloud 托管可包含 CMS 许可，但商业插件仍单独许可。表单和 SEO 标为“With Plugin”，兼容第一方电商不证明商店许可/支付费包含。托管价格与资源需独立 Cloud 报价。Team/Pro 可在非公开样式开发域名试用，不等于无限免费生产权利。

sections.title_en: Deploy eligible versions before the update window closes
sections.title_zh: 在更新期结束前实际部署目标版本
sections.en: The current licensing guide says paid licenses are perpetual for the installed licensed version. Updates become licensed only when actually performed and deployed during an active update window; a release date within the old window is not enough if you never installed it then. You can renew later without paying for gaps, and auto-renew reminders30days ahead lock the notified price for that renewal. The Craft updater respects expired package eligibility, whereas direct Composer update does not know licensing status and can install unlicensed newer packages. Verify both CMS and plugin eligibility in the deployment workflow and test backups before upgrades. A legacy pre-April4,2018 CMS license does not extend grandfathering to later-added plugins or lifetime developer support.
sections.zh: 当前许可指南称已安装的已许可版本可永久运行。更新须在有效更新期内实际执行并部署才取得许可，版本发布时间落在旧更新期内但当时未安装，不足以取得该版本权利。可间隔后再续，不为中断期补费；自动续费提前30天提醒，并按提醒价处理该次续费。Craft 更新器尊重到期资格，直接 Composer update 不知道许可状态，可能安装未许可的新包。部署流程应核对 CMS/插件资格，升级前验证备份。2018年4月4日前的旧 CMS 许可不将永久更新资格传递给后装插件，也不包含终身开发者支持。

sections.title_en: Resolve Solo usage and source-license boundaries
sections.title_zh: 澄清 Solo 用途及源码许可边界
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says Solo client work is technically possible but recommends Team/Pro so non-developers do not receive unrestricted administrator access. The May2024 terms instead restrict Solo to noncommercial personal/friend sites. Preserve this discrepancy and obtain current written confirmation for commercial Solo use. Craft’s custom license is source-available with production-instance/payment/license-feature conditions, not an unrestricted open-source grant; using open-source dependencies does not make the CMS itself permissively licensed. This can fit a developer-led content team wanting a bespoke front end and authoring model. A no-code-only team must budget implementation/hosting/support. No authoring, permission enforcement, GraphQL, plugin installation, update, backup or deployment was tested.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 称 Solo 技术上可用于客户项目，但建议 Team/Pro，避免给非开发者无限管理员访问。2024年5月条款却将 Solo 限为非商业个人/朋友网站，应保留差异，商业 Solo 用途需取得当前书面确认。Craft 自定义许可提供可见源码，但附有生产实例、付款及许可功能限制，不是无限制开源授权；采用开源依赖不等于 CMS 本身为宽松开源。希望自定义前端和作者模型的开发团队可考虑它，仅无代码团队则需预算实现/托管/支持。本次未实测创作、权限、GraphQL、插件安装、更新、备份或部署。
